title: Payroll and Hiring Run Through These 3 Companies, and $90,000 Across Them Pays $3,667 a Year
summary: Two of these dividend payers profit from every paycheck you receive, while the third lives or dies by whether companies keep hiring. One of them already pays out more than it earns, and the jobs report could decide its fate.
